title: The maps Standard Library: get/3, find/2, update_with/4, merge/2 & fold/3
solutionExplanation: Demonstrates maps:get/3 fallback defaults, atomic histogram counting via maps:update_with/4, config sanitization via maps:merge/2 and maps:without/2, and maps:fold/3 aggregation.

mentalModelCheck.question: In maps:merge(Defaults, Overrides), what happens if a key exists in both maps?

options.label: The value from Overrides (the second map argument) overwrites the value from Defaults
options.explanation: In maps:merge/2, the second map always takes precedence when duplicate keys are present.

options.label: The BEAM VM raises a {badkey, conflict} exception
options.explanation: maps:merge/2 does not crash on conflicts; it resolves them in favor of the second argument.

options.label: The value from Defaults is preserved unless Overrides is non-empty
